svg.text: Detective flow: event to finding to action
Numbered runtime path for a single resource change, plus the nightly sweep safety net
Audience: Engineer / SRE | Notation: AWS-style flow | Scope: Runtime path
Note: Event path gives minutes-level detection; the sweep catches missed or dropped events so correctness never depends on one delivery.
